authority_coordinate.agreement_rule: Any Markdown/JSON semantic, schema, ordering, stage, or scope mismatch is an integrity failure requiring fail-closed refusal.

canonical_json_profile.array_order: Preserved exactly unless a field schema explicitly classifies the field as an unordered semantic set.
canonical_json_profile.unordered_set_rule: Validate members, encode each member recursively under this profile, reject duplicate encoded members, and sort by encoded bytes.
canonical_json_profile.separators: Comma and colon with no surrounding whitespace.
canonical_json_profile.escaping: Shortest JSON escape required by RFC 8259; preserve non-ASCII Unicode as UTF-8.
canonical_json_profile.top_level_line_termination: Exactly one LF for projected fixture and projection documents; no LF inside a digest preimage unless the schema field contains one.
canonical_json_profile.strict_parse: Reject trailing content and duplicate keys before semantic validation.

canonical_byte_construction.normalized_payload_shape: A seven-member JSON array whose members follow root_field_order exactly; each member is recursively normalized under CTMP_CANONICAL_JSON_V1, with unordered and ordered fields treated by their frozen field classifications.

canonical_algorithm: Strictly parse and validate the declared value domain and exact schema.
Normalize strings to the requirement that input is already NFC; reject rather than mutate non-NFC input.
Resolve the exact local-vertex permutation domain while preserving every color and layer.
Enumerate all n! permutations in lexicographic permutation order.
For each permutation, normalize unordered semantic sets and preserve ordered fields.
Serialize the complete schema-versioned layered object with CANONICAL_TOPOLOGY_SERIALIZE_V1.
Select the lexicographically least serialized byte string.
Construct the identity preimage with the exact digest-preimage profile.
Return canonical bytes, minimizing permutation witness, supported size, and CanonicalTopologyId.

mathematical_contract.relabeling_invariance: For every sigma in S_n, Can_v(sigma Theta)=Can_v(Theta).
mathematical_contract.isomorphism_characterization: Under a faithful normalized colored layered encoding, Can_v(Theta)=Can_v(Theta') iff Theta and Theta' are color- and layer-preserving isomorphic.
mathematical_contract.digest_assumption: Collision resistance only; the digest is not the isomorphism proof.
mathematical_contract.performance_nonidentity: Measured EBU, service, feasibility, robustness, causal, settlement, fairness, and social values are excluded from canonical bytes and CanonicalTopologyId.

recursive_motif_contract.definition: M_{n+1}=C(M_n,M_{n-1}) for n>=1 with ordered child roles.
recursive_motif_contract.bounded_composition_cost: Exactly n-1 new Phi calls through level n after two bases; O(n) when summary size and Phi cost are uniformly bounded.
recursive_motif_contract.polynomial_cost: If s_k=O(k^d) and Phi costs O((s_k+s_{k-1})^p), T(n)=O(n^{dp+1}), subject to output size and A1-A8.

a1_a8.name: sufficiency

a1_a8.name: interaction_preservation

a1_a8.name: dependency_completeness

a1_a8.name: history_wide_equivalence

f13_authoritative_raw_mobius.domain: Every S subseteq A, including empty.
f13_authoritative_raw_mobius.authority_relation: This is the unchanged Atomic F13 full-subset coefficient.

normalized_mobius.nonempty_definition: For S nonempty, I_norm(S)=sum_{T subseteq S} (-1)^(|S|-|T|) E_tilde(T).
normalized_mobius.empty_distinction: I_norm(empty)=0 is a normalization convention and is not the raw F13 coefficient I_raw(empty)=E(empty).
normalized_mobius.proof: For nonempty S, sum_{T subseteq S} (-1)^(|S|-|T|)=(1-1)^|S|=0, so subtracting E(empty) from every subset value contributes zero.

raw_correction_locality.domain: Every Q,S subseteq A, including Q=S=empty.
raw_correction_locality.statement: If only raw E(Q) changes by delta, Delta I_raw(S)=(-1)^(|S|-|Q|) delta when Q subseteq S, and 0 otherwise.

normalized_correction_response.nonempty_statement: For every nonempty S, Delta I_norm(S)=Delta I_raw(S) under any one-entry raw correction, including Q=empty.
normalized_correction_response.baseline_correction: If Q=empty and S is nonempty, both deltas are (-1)^|S| delta.
normalized_correction_response.empty_statement: I_norm(empty) remains 0 under every raw correction.

nonzero_empty_baseline_examples.pair: E(empty),E(a),E(b),E(ab)=(5,8,9,15); I_raw=(5,3,4,3) and I_norm=(0,3,4,3) in subset order empty,a,b,ab.
nonzero_empty_baseline_examples.pure_three_way: For A={a,b,c}, E(T)=5 for every proper T and E(abc)=11; I_raw(empty)=5, every nonempty coefficient below order three is 0, and I_raw(abc)=I_norm(abc)=6.

arbitrary_black_box_lower_bound.statement: Any exact worst-case reconstruction of an arbitrary subset table and all Boolean Möbius coefficients requires every subset entry.
arbitrary_black_box_lower_bound.witness: With fewer than 2^N queries choose unqueried Q, change only E(Q) by nonzero delta, preserve all observed inputs, and change every raw coefficient I_raw(S) on Q's upward cone, including the empty coefficient when Q=empty.
arbitrary_black_box_lower_bound.purpose: Topology, equivalence, feasible-domain restriction, factorization, and sufficient boundaries are the information that can justify compression.
